title: Load the selected workspace
responsibility: Loads the project snapshot and optional entity named by a workspace address, determines available actions, and makes cached views read-only.

inputs.name: loadWorkspace.bridge
inputs.description: The desktop connection used to select a project, read its snapshot and optional entity, and obtain its allowed actions. Project selection is skipped when the connection does not offer it.

inputs.name: loadWorkspace.route
inputs.description: The parsed address naming the optional project, branch, commit and entity. A newly selected snapshot is reused only when no commit is pinned and its branch matches any requested branch; otherwise a separate snapshot is requested.

inputs.name: loadWorkspace.selection
inputs.description: A mutable record of the last selected project identity, or null when unknown. Switching clears it before selection, so a failed selection leaves it null. Successful selection and a returned snapshot identity update it.

outputs.name: loadWorkspace
outputs.description: A promise containing the snapshot, entity or null, allowed actions, and cached-view information or null. Entity reads use the returned snapshot commit and project identity. A cached snapshot is returned with writing disabled and all change actions disabled, even if its saved capabilities allowed them.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The promise rejects if the snapshot names a different project from the one requested. Project-selection, snapshot and entity-read failures also propagate. Failure to read capabilities instead yields disabled actions and a reason.
